BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,753,315 ordinary shares on 08 June 2026 for an average price of 253.4105 pence per share, 1,500,000 ordinary shares on 09 June 2026 for an average price of 254.1984 pence per share, and 278,239 ordinary shares on 10 June 2026 for an average price of 251.8461 pence per share, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. Additionally, 300,000 ordinary shares were purchased on 11 June 2026 at an average price of 254.3004 pence per share, and 298,703 ordinary shares on 12 June 2026 at an average price of 255.6212 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 985,474,993. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 12 June 2026 12 June 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 17,271,021 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 12 June 2026 is 985,474,993 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
